def cache_sim(capacity, ttl, ops):
    from collections import OrderedDict
    
    # cache maps key -> (value, write_time)
    # order_dict tracks LRU order
    cache = {}
    order_dict = OrderedDict()
    results = []
    
    for op in ops:
        if op[0] == 'put':
            _, t, key, value = op
            
            # Check if key already exists and hasn't expired
            if key in cache:
                _, write_time = cache[key]
                if write_time + ttl > t:
                    # Key exists and hasn't expired, update it
                    cache[key] = (value, t)
                    # Move to end (most recently used)
                    order_dict.move_to_end(key)
                else:
                    # Key exists but has expired, treat as absent
                    del cache[key]
                    if key in order_dict:
                        del order_dict[key]
                    # Add new entry
                    if len(cache) >= capacity:
                        # Evict LRU
                        lru_key, _ = order_dict.popitem(last=False)
                        del cache[lru_key]
                    cache[key] = (value, t)
                    order_dict[key] = True
            else:
                # Key is absent
                if len(cache) >= capacity:
                    # Evict LRU
                    lru_key, _ = order_dict.popitem(last=False)
                    del cache[lru_key]
                cache[key] = (value, t)
                order_dict[key] = True
        
        elif op[0] == 'get':
            _, t, key = op
            
            if key in cache:
                value, write_time = cache[key]
                # Check if the entry has expired
                if write_time + ttl > t:
                    # Entry is valid
                    results.append(value)
                    # Move to end (most recently used)
                    order_dict.move_to_end(key)
                else:
                    # Entry has expired
                    del cache[key]
                    del order_dict[key]
                    results.append(-1)
            else:
                # Key is absent
                results.append(-1)
    
    return results
